jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, kreative Ideen.
In unserem Unternehmensbereich «Corporate Functions» sind verschiedene Tätigkeiten gebündelt. Neben unseren Finance- und IT-Services sind in diesem Bereich auch das globale Marketing und Sales Management sowie Human Resources angesiedelt. Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du steuerst den gruppenweiten Budgetierungs- und Forecast-Prozess und verantwortest die strategische Fünfjahresplanung

• Du verdichtest komplexe Zusammenhänge zu klaren Analysen, überzeugenden Präsentationen und fundierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Mit deinen strategischen Empfehlungen unterstützt du die Geschäftsleitung und weitere zentrale Stakeholder bei wichtigen Entscheidunge

• Du analysierst die Performance unserer Ländergesellschaften, prüfst Businesspläne und Forecasts mit einem kritischen Blick und schaffst Transparenz über Chancen und Risiken. Bei Abweichungen initiierst du konkrete Gegenmassnahmen und begleitest ihre konsequente Umsetzung

• Du entwickelst unsere Unternehmenssteuerung weiter und treibst die Einführung moderner BI-, Planungs- und Steuerungsinstrumente aktiv voran

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen oder Controlling erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit

• Du verfügst über fundierte Führungserfahrung im Corporate Controlling oder Financial Planning eines internationalen Konzern- oder Matrixumfelds

• Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen Finanzmodellen und beherrschst die integrierte Planung von Erfolgsrechnung, Bilanz und Cashflow. Moderne BI- und Planungsinstrumente setzt du gezielt ein

• Du verbindest ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit überzeugender Kommunikation auf Geschäftsleitungs- und C-Level. Als Führungspersönlichkeit gibst du Orientierung, setzt klare Prioritäten und handelst strukturiert, vorausschauend und lösungsorientiert

• Du kommunizierst und verhandelst stilsicher in Deutsch und Englisch

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Kostenlose Parkplätze

• Vergünstigungen im Läderach Café und Personalrestaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Fabio Ferramosca , Talent Acquisition Partner, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben.

Nun schreiben wir ein neues Kapitel: Mit der Neueröffnung unseres ersten Outlets in der Schweiz schaffen wir einen weiteren Ort, an dem Schokoladenliebhaberinnen und-liebhaber die Welt von Läderach entdecken können. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du unterstützt die Filialleitung bei der täglichen Führung und Organisation der Filiale

• Du übernimmst bei Abwesenheit der Filialleitung die operative Verantwortung für die Filiale und stellst den reibungslosen Ablauf sicher

• Du bietest eine kompetente, kundenorientierte Beratung und unterstützt bei der Auswahl von Geschenken aus unserem vielfältigen Warensortiment

• Du sorgst für die ansprechende Präsentation unseres umfangreichen Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiments, unter anderem durch kreative Ladengestaltung

• Du garantierst Spitzenqualität und setzt unsere hohen Standards konsequent um

• Du gehst als Vorbild im Verkauf voran und unterstützt das Team aktiv im Tagesgeschäft

• Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für das Team und für die Kundinnen und Kunden

• Du trägst zur Optimierung von Arbeitsabläufen bei und stellst sicher, dass die Filiale effizient und profitabel arbeitet

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast eine Ausbildung im Detailhandel abgeschlossen und/oder bringst
vergleichbare Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Lebensmitteln mit

• Du bringst erste Führungserfahrung mit, vorzugsweise von grösseren Teams

• Du verfügst idealerweise über erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Schokolade

• Du liebst eine Hands-on-Mentalität und bist technisch affin

• Du bist optimierungsfreudig und verfügst über ein unternehmerisches Denken

• Du hast ein ausserordentliches Qualitäts- und Hygienebewusstsein

• Du schätzt eine offene und respektvolle Kommunikation und beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sicher; Kenntnisse in Französisch und weiteren Sprachen sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil

• Du hast keine Scheu vor flexiblen Arbeitszeiten (Schichtbetrieb) und bist auch an Wochenenden oder Feiertagen voll dabei

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Attraktive Verkaufsprämie bei gemeinsamer Zielerreichung

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Karin Spring, Filialleiterin, +41 31 312 21 02, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cioccolata fresca di alta qualità – ecco cosa rappresenta il produttore svizzero di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative nelle squadre agili.
La divisione “Retail” comprende oltre 250 cioccolatini in oltre 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare il cioccolato fresco ancora e ancora. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Si consiglia di orientare il cliente e vendere la nostra gamma di prodotti diversi, per esempio nella selezione di regali

• Rispondete attivamente ai nostri clienti, riconoscete le loro esigenze e offrite soluzioni adeguate

• Prendersi cura dei processi di cassa e garantire una fatturazione precisa e corretta

• Vi presentiamo la squisita gamma di confiserie e cioccolato in un modo raffinato e invitante

• Si occupa anche di attività di produzione, nonché il riempimento e la manutenzione delle aree di vendita

• Attui i nostri standard di alta qualità con dedizione e cura

• Si presta costantemente attenzione al rispetto del concetto di igiene e freschezza

• Lavori di pari passo con il tuo team e contribuisci ad un ambiente di lavoro positivo

Lo porti con te.

• Porti esperienza professionale nel commercio al dettaglio e sei entusiasta delle vendite e del contatto diretto con i clienti

• Riconosci le esigenze del cliente rapidamente e consiglia amichevole, individuale e convincente

• Hai una buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese; francese e altre lingue sono utili

• Si lavora in modo responsabile, affidabile e di qualità orientato e rispettare costantemente gli standard di igiene e pulizia

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, come assumersi la responsabilità e vuole sviluppare ulteriormente nelle vendite e nel servizio

• Sei flessibile e pronto per le assegnazioni nei fine settimana e nelle vacanze

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Buona accessibilità dei luoghi

Sembra interessante? Allora applicaci. Dajana Mandal, Branch Manager, +41 61 691 80 90, è a vostra disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.

Chiediamo la vostra comprensione che non consideriamo agenzie di reclutamento esterne durante il riempimento di questa posizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring that with you

• You bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop further in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Dajana Mandal, Branch Manager, +41 61 691 80 90, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Le siège de l'entreprise est situé dans le canton de Glarus. Devant un décor alpin pittoresque, nous produisons ici nos chocolats frais et développons constamment de nouvelles idées innovantes dans des équipes agiles.
La division « Retail » comprend plus de 250 chocolateries dans plus de 30 pays. Ici, nous offrons nos spécialités de chocolat et invitons nos clients à découvrir le chocolat frais encore et encore. Voulez-vous également participer? Alors venez nous voir.

C'est ce qui vous attend.

• Vous conseillez le client et vendez notre gamme de produits, par exemple dans la sélection de cadeaux

• Vous répondez activement à nos clients, reconnaissez leurs besoins et offrez des solutions adaptées

• Vous prenez soin des processus de trésorerie et assurez une facturation précise et correcte

• Vous présentez la confiserie exquise et la gamme de chocolats d'une manière agréable et accueillante

• Vous prenez également des activités de production ainsi que le remplissage et l'entretien des zones de vente

• Vous travaillez de manière responsable, fiable et orientée vers la qualité et respectez constamment les normes d'hygiène et de propreté

• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe, aimez prendre des responsabilités et voulez développer davantage dans les ventes et le service

C'est ce que nous vous offrons

• Un environnement de travail passionnant avec des collègues motivés

• Un poste avec beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles

• L'occasion d'apporter de nouvelles idées

• Une culture de rétroaction ouverte et respectueuse

• Chocolat sur le lieu de travail

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda a conduzione familiare impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da oltre 80 paesi, ed è ora sempre più attiva nel gruppo. La sede dell'azienda si trova nel cantone di Glarona. Di fronte al pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi e sviluppiamo nuove idee innovative nei team dell'azienda. La divisione "Retail" comprende oltre 250 cioccolatini in oltre 30 paesi.

Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare sempre cioccolato fresco. Vuoi partecipare a questo? Allora vieni da noi.

Ecco cosa ti aspetta.

• Lei consiglia il nostro cliente e vende la nostra gamma di prodotti diversi, ad esempio nella selezione dei regali

• Agganciate attivamente i nostri clienti, riconoscete le loro esigenze e offrite soluzioni adeguate

• Si prende cura delle operazioni di cassa e garantire un regolamento preciso e corretto

• Presentate il squisito assortimento di consumer e cioccolato in modo gustoso e invitante

• Si assume anche attività produttive e la riempimento e manutenzione dello spazio di vendita

• Implementa i nostri standard di qualità con dedizione e cura

• Si presta attenzione costantemente al rispetto del concetto di igiene e freschezza

• Lavorate di pari passo con il vostro team e contribuirete ad un ambiente di lavoro positivo

Porta questo con te

• Portate esperienza professionale nel commercio al dettaglio e siete entusiasti delle vendite e del contatto diretto con il cliente

• Riconosci rapidamente le esigenze dei clienti e consiglia amichevoli, individuali e convincenti

• Conoscete bene il tedesco e l'inglese; il francese e altre lingue sono di grande vantaggio

• Lavori in modo responsabile, affidabile e orientato alla qualità e rispetti costantemente gli standard di igiene e pulizia

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, sei felice di assumersi la responsabilità e vuoi sviluppare in vendita e servizio

• Siete flessibili e pronti per il fine settimana e festivi

Te lo concediamo.

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con una grande responsabilità personale

• La possibilità di portare idee nuove

• Una cultura del feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Generosi sconti sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Buona accessibilità dei siti

Suona interessante? Allora fai domanda a noi. Karin Spring, responsabile di filiale, +41 31 312 21 02, è a tua disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.

Chiediamo di capire che non prendiamo in considerazione le agenzie esterne del personale al momento di ricoprire questa posizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The company is based in the canton of Glarus. Founded in 1962, the family-run company employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries, and is now increasingly active in the group. The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. In front of the picturesque alpine scenery, we produce our fresh chocolates and develop new, innovative ideas in the teams of the company. The "Retail" division comprises over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries.

Here we offer our chocolate specialities and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you want to participate in this? Then come to us.

That's what awaits you

• You advise our customer-oriented and sell our diverse range of goods, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively engage our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cashing operations and ensure a precise and correct settlement

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate assortment in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on manufacturing activities and the filling and maintenance of the sales space

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring this with you

• You bring professional experience in retail and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You quickly recognize customer needs and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are of advantage

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, are happy to take responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for weekend and public holidays

We'll give you that

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The possibility of bringing fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate at the workplace

• Good accessibility of the sites

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Karin Spring, branch manager, +41 31 312 21 02, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for understanding that we do not take external personnel agencies into account when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Fondée en 1962, la société familiale emploie plus de 2 500 personnes de plus de 80 pays et est désormais de plus en plus active dans le groupe. Le siège social de la société se trouve dans le canton de Glarus. Face au paysage alpin pittoresque, nous produisons nos chocolats frais et développons des idées innovantes dans les équipes de la société. La division « Retail » regroupe plus de 250 chocolateries dans plus de 30 pays.

Nous vous proposons nos spécialités chocolatées et invitons nos clients à découvrir encore et encore du chocolat frais. Voulez-vous y participer? Venez donc à nous.

C'est ce qui vous attend.

• Vous engagez activement nos clients, reconnaissez leurs besoins et offrez des solutions adaptées

• Vous prenez soin des opérations de mise encaissement et vous assurez un règlement précis et correct

• Vous présentez l'excellente confiserie et l'assortiment de chocolat d'une manière agréable et accueillante

• Vous vous lancez également dans les activités de fabrication et le remplissage et l'entretien de l'espace de vente

• Vous appliquez nos normes de qualité avec dévouement et soin

• Vous faites attention au respect du concept d'hygiène et de fraîcheur

• Vous travaillez main dans la main avec votre équipe et contribuez à un environnement de travail positif

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Vous apportez une expérience professionnelle dans le commerce de détail et êtes enthousiastes à l'égard des ventes et contact direct avec le client

• Vous reconnaissez rapidement les besoins des clients et vous conseillez amicalement, individuellement et convaincant

• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais; le français et d'autres langues sont d'avantage

• Vous travaillez de manière responsable, fiable et orientée vers la qualité et vous respectez constamment les normes d'hygiène et de propreté

• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe, êtes heureux de prendre la responsabilité et de vouloir développer dans les ventes et le service

• Vous êtes flexible et prêt pour le week-end et les jours fériés

On vous donne ça.

• Un environnement de travail passionnant avec des collègues motivés

• Un poste avec beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles

• La possibilité d'apporter de nouvelles idées

• Une culture ouverte et respectueuse de la rétroaction

Karin Spring, directeur de succursale, +41 312 21 02, est à votre disposition pour toutes questions.

Neben unseren Finance- und IT-Services sind in diesem Bereich auch das globale Marketing und Sales Management sowie Human Resources angesiedelt. Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

• Du kommunizierst bereichs- und länderübergreifend

• Du bereitest KPI-Reports auf und erstellst diese eigenständig

• Du übernimmst teaminterne Stellvertretungen

• Du verfügst über eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit einer fachspezifischen Weiterbildung (z.B. im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain oder Planung) oder über einen Abschluss einer Fachhochschule bzw. einer vergleichbaren höheren Fachausbildung

• Du bringst Erfahrung in der Bedarfsplanung, Disposition, Beschaffung oder einem vergleichbaren analytischen Bereich mit

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis und analytisches Denkvermögen

Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee creative nelle squadre agili.
Varie attività sono raggruppate nella nostra divisione Corporate Functions. Oltre ai nostri servizi finanziari e IT, questo settore include anche la gestione globale del marketing e delle vendite, nonché le risorse umane. Ogni giorno vengono create idee fresche, che insieme conduciamo al successo. La responsabilità personale e il lavoro in rete sono particolarmente importanti per noi. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Coordinate gli ordini stagionali

• Si analizzano i dati storici e si ricavano approfondimenti rilevanti per la pianificazione del volume stagionale

• Si accompagna la pianificazione del volume di nuovi lanci in stretta collaborazione con il marketing

• Crea e mantieni la pianificazione delle esigenze a breve e lungo termine (forecast)

Lo porti con te.

• Porti esperienza nella pianificazione della domanda, pianificazione, approvvigionamento o un campo analitico comparabile

• Hai una forte comprensione dei numeri e delle capacità di pensiero analitico

• Sei molto abile nel trattare con Microsoft Excel; La conoscenza degli strumenti di potere (ad esempio, Power Query / Power Pivot) è un vantaggio

• Hai esperienza con sistemi ERP, idealmente con CEE

• Si comunica in modo sicuro in tedesco e inglese

• Si distinguono attraverso la consapevolezza della qualità e un senso di responsabilità

• Lavori in modo indipendente, flessibile, orientato al team e impegnato

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Opportunità di carriera individuali

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, creative ideas in agile teams.
Various activities are bundled in our Corporate Functions division. In addition to our finance and IT services, this area also includes global marketing and sales management as well as human resources. Every day fresh ideas are created here, which together we lead to success. Personal responsibility and networked work are particularly important to us. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You coordinate the seasonal orders

• You analyze historical data and derive relevant insights for seasonal volume planning

• You accompany the volume planning of new launches in close cooperation with marketing

• You create and maintain the short- and long-term needs planning (forecast)

• You communicate across departments and countries

• You prepare KPI reports and create them independently

• You take over team-internal representatives

You bring that with you

• You have a commercial education with a subject-specific further education (e.g. in the field of business administration, supply chain or planning) or a degree from a university of applied sciences or a comparable higher vocational training

• You bring experience in demand planning, scheduling, procurement or a comparable analytical field

• You have a strong understanding of numbers and analytical thinking skills

• You are very adept at dealing with Microsoft Excel; Knowledge of Power Tools (e.g. Power Query / Power Pivot) is an advantage

• You have experience with ERP systems, ideally with CEE

• You communicate safely in German and English

• You distinguish yourself through quality awareness and a sense of responsibility

• You work independently, flexibly, team-oriented and engaged

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner, is happy to help you with any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Chocolat frais de haute qualité – c'est ce que représente le fabricant suisse de chocolat Läderach. Fondée en 1962, l'entreprise familiale emploie aujourd'hui plus de 2 500 personnes de plus de 80 pays dans l'ensemble du Groupe, et la tendance est à la hausse. Le siège de l'entreprise est situé dans le canton de Glarus. Devant un décor alpin pittoresque, nous produisons ici nos chocolats frais et développons constamment de nouvelles idées créatives dans des équipes agiles.
Diverses activités sont regroupées dans notre division Fonctions corporatives. Outre nos services financiers et informatiques, ce domaine comprend également la gestion du marketing et des ventes à l'échelle mondiale ainsi que les ressources humaines. Chaque jour de nouvelles idées sont créées ici, qui ensemble nous conduisons au succès. La responsabilité personnelle et le travail en réseau sont particulièrement importants pour nous. Voulez-vous également participer? Alors venez nous voir.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family-owned company today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive work climate

You bring that with you

• You have successfully completed the apprenticeship in the retail trade, bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop further in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Attractive sales premium for joint achievement of goals

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Hatice Manis, Branch Manager, +41 61 261 54 48, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family-owned company today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive work climate

You bring that with you

• You bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop further in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Karin Spring, store manager, +41 31 312 21 02, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee creative in team agili.
Varie attività sono raggruppate nella nostra divisione Corporate Functions. Oltre ai nostri servizi finanziari e IT, questo settore include anche la gestione globale del marketing e delle vendite, nonché le risorse umane. Ogni giorno vengono create idee fresche, che insieme conduciamo al successo. La responsabilità personale e il lavoro in rete sono particolarmente importanti per noi. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Supporti il Responsabile della Categoria Materie prime nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di approvvigionamento per ingredienti alimentari chiave e materie prime come cacao, noci, zucchero, prodotti caseari, grassi, oli e altre materie prime alimentari

• Sei indipendentemente responsabile per i fornitori selezionati e le attività di acquisto, valutare le loro prestazioni e identificare il potenziale di miglioramento e ottimizzazione dei costi

• Preparare i negoziati commerciali, gli accordi e i contratti dei fornitori e condurre i processi di approvvigionamento e di offerta selezionati dall'analisi del mercato all'attuazione

• Analizzerai i mercati internazionali delle materie prime, le tendenze delle materie prime, gli sviluppi delle colture, le fluttuazioni valutarie e i rischi di approvvigionamento e creerai le corrispondenti analisi di mercato e di acquisto

• Sosterrete la creazione e l'espansione di una rete di fornitori internazionali e identificare e qualificare fornitori alternativi e opportunità di approvvigionamento.

• Lavorate a stretto contatto con la supply chain, la pianificazione della produzione, la gestione della qualità, lo sviluppo del prodotto, la sostenibilità e la pianificazione della domanda di sostegno, la gestione dell'inventario e la sicurezza dell'offerta

• Assicura la corretta manutenzione dei dati di fornitore, prezzo, contratto e materiale master nel sistema ERP

• Crea cruscotti KPI e principi decisionali per la gestione

• Lavori su progetti relativi all'approvvigionamento di eccellenza, al miglioramento dei processi, alla sostenibilità e all'ottimizzazione dei costi

Lo porti con te.

• Hai una laurea o una qualifica simile in amministrazione aziendale, gestione della supply chain, acquisto o un campo correlato

• Porti almeno 5 anni di esperienza nell'acquisto o nell'approvvigionamento, idealmente negli alimenti, ingredienti, materie prime agricole, FMCG o industrie manifatturiere

• Hai esperienza nella gestione dei fornitori, nell'acquisto strategico e nel lavoro con fornitori internazionali e catene di fornitura globali

• Hai forti competenze analitiche e interesse nei mercati delle materie prime, negli sviluppi dei prezzi e nei rischi di approvvigionamento

• Porti comprovate capacità di negoziazione e di gestione degli stakeholder.

• Hai un'alta affinità e un'esperienza ERP con Comarch, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics o sistemi comparabili, nonché una buona conoscenza di Excel e reporting

• Si lavora in modo strutturato, pratico e proattivo, prestando attenzione ai dettagli ed essendo in grado di controllare più priorità in un ambiente dinamico.

• Potrai idealmente portare l'esperienza con materie prime agricole o ingredienti alimentari, nonché la conoscenza di standard alimentari e requisiti di qualità come IFS, BRCGS, FSSC 22000 e HACCP

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, creative ideas in agile teams.
Various activities are bundled in our Corporate Functions division. In addition to our finance and IT services, this area also includes global marketing and sales management as well as human resources. Every day fresh ideas are created here, which together we lead to success. Personal responsibility and networked work are particularly important to us. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You support the Raw Materials Category Manager in the development and implementation of procurement strategies for key food ingredients and raw materials such as cocoa, nuts, sugar, dairy products, fats, oils and other food raw materials

• You are independently responsible for selected suppliers and purchasing activities, evaluate their performance and identify potential for improvement and cost optimization

• Prepare commercial negotiations, supplier agreements and contracts and lead selected sourcing and tendering processes from market analysis to implementation

• You will analyze international commodity markets, commodity trends, crop developments, currency fluctuations and supply risks and create corresponding market and purchasing analyses

• You will support the establishment and expansion of an international supplier network and identify and qualify alternative suppliers and procurement opportunities.

• You work closely with supply chain, production planning, quality management, product development, sustainability and finance and support demand planning, inventory management and security of supply

• You ensure the correct maintenance of supplier, price, contract and material master data in the ERP system

• Create KPI dashboards and decision-making principles for management

• You work on projects related to procurement excellence, process improvement, sustainability and cost optimization

You bring that with you

• You have a bachelor’s degree or comparable qualification in business administration, supply chain management, purchasing or a related field

• You bring at least 5 years of experience in purchasing or procurement, ideally in the food, ingredients, agricultural raw materials, FMCG or manufacturing industries

• You have experience in supplier management, strategic purchasing and working with international suppliers and global supply chains

• You have strong analytical skills and interest in commodity markets, price developments and procurement risks

• You bring proven negotiating and stakeholder management skills.

• You have a high ERP affinity and experience with Comarch, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable systems as well as very good knowledge of Excel and reporting

• You work in a structured, hands-on and proactive way, paying attention to details and being able to control multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

• You will ideally bring experience with agricultural raw materials or food ingredients as well as knowledge of food standards and quality requirements such as IFS, BRCGS, FSSC 22000 and HACCP

• Ideally, you will have knowledge of sustainability, ESG, Responsible Sourcing, Commodity Risk Management, Contract Management and Market Analysis and will be interested in macroeconomic, currency and geopolitical developments.

• You speak German and English fluently at business level; Spanish and/or Portuguese as well as other language skills are advantageous

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative nelle squadre agili.
La divisione “Retail” comprende più di 250 cioccolatini in più di 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare il cioccolato fresco ancora e ancora. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Si consiglia di orientare il cliente e vendere la nostra gamma di prodotti diversi, per esempio nella selezione di regali

• Rispondete attivamente ai nostri clienti, riconoscete le loro esigenze e offrite soluzioni adeguate

• Prendersi cura dei processi di cassa e garantire una fatturazione precisa e corretta

• Vi presentiamo la squisita gamma di confiserie e cioccolato in un modo raffinato e invitante

• Si occupa anche di attività di produzione, nonché il riempimento e la manutenzione delle aree di vendita

• Attui i nostri standard di alta qualità con dedizione e cura

• Si presta costantemente attenzione al rispetto del concetto di igiene e freschezza

• Lavori di pari passo con il tuo team e contribuisci a un ambiente di lavoro positivo

Lo porti con te.

• Hai completato con successo l'apprendistato nel commercio al dettaglio, portare esperienza professionale nel commercio al dettaglio e sono entusiasti circa le vendite e il contatto diretto del cliente

• Riconosci le esigenze del cliente rapidamente e consiglia amichevole, individuale e convincente

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese; francese e altre lingue sono utili

• Si lavora in modo responsabile, affidabile e orientato alla qualità e rispettare costantemente gli standard di igiene e pulizia

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, come assumersi la responsabilità e vogliono svilupparsi in vendite e servizi

• Sei flessibile e pronto per le assegnazioni nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Formazione interna ed esterna

• Opportunità di carriera individuali

• Premio di vendita attraente per il raggiungimento congiunto di obiettivi

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Buona accessibilità dei luoghi

Da solo. Crescete. Fallo fresco.

Sembra interessante? Allora applicaci. Karin Morger, store manager, +41 31 311 04 25, è a vostra disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.

Chiediamo la vostra comprensione che non consideriamo agenzie di reclutamento esterne durante il riempimento di questa posizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring that with you

• You have successfully completed the apprenticeship in the retail trade, bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Attractive sales premium for joint achievement of goals

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Karin Morger, store manager, +41 31 311 04 25, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du berätst kundenorientiert und verkaufst unser vielfältiges Warensortiment, zum Beispiel bei der Geschenkauswahl

• Du gehst aktiv auf unsere Kundinnen und Kunden ein, erkennst ihre Bedürfnisse und bietest passende Lösungen an

• Du kümmerst dich um die Kassiervorgänge und sorgst für eine präzise und korrekte Abrechnung

• Du präsentierst das erlesene Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiment auf eine geschmackvolle und einladende Weise

• Du übernimmst auch produzierende Tätigkeiten sowie das Auffüllen und die Pflege der Verkaufsflächen

• Du setzt unsere hohen Qualitätsstandards mit Hingabe und Sorgfalt um

• Du achtest konsequent auf die Einhaltung des Hygiene- und Frischekonzepts

• Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinem Team und trägst zu einem positiven Arbeitsklima bei

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast die Lehre im Detailhandel erfolgreich absolviert, bringst Berufserfahrung im Detailhandel mit und begeisterst dich für den Verkauf sowie den direkten Kundenkontakt

• Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und berätst freundlich, individuell und überzeugend

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französisch und weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil

• Du arbeitest verantwortungsbewusst, zuverlässig und qualitätsorientiert und hältst Hygiene- und Sauberkeitsstandards konsequent ein

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest dich im Verkauf und Service weiterentwickeln

• Du bist flexibel und bereit für Einsätze an Wochenenden und Feiertagen

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Attraktive Verkaufsprämie bei gemeinsamer Zielerreichung

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Karin Morger, Filialleiterin, +41 31 311 04 25, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chocolat frais de haute qualité – c'est ce que représente le fabricant suisse de chocolat Läderach. Fondée en 1962, l'entreprise familiale emploie aujourd'hui plus de 2 500 personnes de plus de 80 pays dans l'ensemble du Groupe, et la tendance est à la hausse. Le siège de l'entreprise est situé dans le canton de Glarus. Devant un décor alpin pittoresque, nous produisons ici nos chocolats frais et développons constamment de nouvelles idées innovantes en équipe agile.
La division « Retail » comprend plus de 250 chocolateries dans plus de 30 pays. Ici, nous offrons nos spécialités de chocolat et invitons les clients à découvrir le chocolat frais encore et encore. Voulez-vous également participer? Alors venez nous voir.

C'est ce qui vous attend

• Vous conseillez le client et vendez notre gamme de produits, par exemple dans la sélection de cadeaux

• Vous répondez activement à nos clients, reconnaissez leurs besoins et offrez des solutions adaptées

• Vous prenez soin des processus de trésorerie et assurez une facturation précise et correcte

• Vous présentez la confiserie exquise et la gamme de chocolats d'une manière agréable et accueillante

• Vous prenez également des activités de production ainsi que le remplissage et l'entretien des zones de vente

• Vous appliquez nos normes de haute qualité avec dévouement et soin

• Vous faites toujours attention au respect du concept d'hygiène et de fraîcheur

• Vous travaillez main dans la main avec votre équipe et contribuez à un environnement de travail positif

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Vous avez réussi l'apprentissage dans le commerce de détail, apportez une expérience professionnelle dans le commerce de détail et êtes enthousiaste à l'égard des ventes et contact direct avec la clientèle

• Vous reconnaissez les besoins du client rapidement et conseillez amical, individuel et convaincant

• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais; le français et d'autres langues sont bénéfiques

• Vous travaillez de manière responsable, fiable et orientée vers la qualité et vous respectez constamment les normes d'hygiène et de propreté

• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe, aimez prendre des responsabilités et voulez développer dans les ventes et le service

• Vous êtes flexible et prêt pour les affectations le week-end et les vacances

C'est ce que nous vous offrons.

• Un environnement de travail passionnant avec des collègues motivés

• Un poste avec beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles

• L'occasion d'apporter de nouvelles idées

• Une culture de rétroaction ouverte et respectueuse

• Formation interne et externe

• Possibilités de carrière individuelles

• Prime de vente attractive pour la réalisation conjointe des objectifs

• Des rabais généreux sur nos produits

• Chocolat sur le lieu de travail

• Bonne accessibilité des sites

Pose-le. Fais grandir. Fais-le frais.

Ça semble intéressant ? Alors appliquez-nous. Karin Morger, chef de magasin, +41 31 311 04 25, est à votre disposition pour toutes questions.

Nous demandons que vous compreniez que nous ne prenons pas en considération les agences de recrutement externes pour combler ce poste.

Frische, Handwerk, Schweiz – dafür steht die Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt unser Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus rund 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen.
In unserem Unternehmensbereich «Corporate Functions» sind verschiedene Tätigkeiten gebündelt. Neben unseren Finance- und IT-Services sind in diesem Bereich auch das globale Marketing und Sales Management sowie Human Resources angesiedelt. Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du stellst einen zuverlässigen und serviceorientierten 1st- und 2nd-Level Support für unsere internationalen Filialen sicher (über 200 Stores)

• Du bearbeitest Incidents und Service Requests effizient und lösungsorientiert und stellst die nachhaltige Fehlerbehebung sicher

• Du entwickelst deine Eigenlösungskompetenz im 2nd Level kontinuierlich weiter und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Themen

• Du pflegst und erstellst Knowledge Base Artikel, FAQs und Manuals, um die Lösungsqualität und Geschwindigkeit nachhaltig zu verbessern

• Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Filialeröffnungen und Umbauten (IT-seitig)

• Du installierst und konfigurierst Store IT Systeme (POS, Netzwerk, Peripherie) vor Ort oder remote

• Du besuchst regelmässig unsere Filialen und stellst die Stabilität der Store IT sicher

• Du beteiligst dich am Pikett-/Bereitschaftsdienst, um den operativen Betrieb sicherzustellen

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT Support (1st/2nd Level), in einem Retail- oder serviceorientierten Umfeld

• Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Store IT / Retail Systeme (z. B. POS, Netzwerk, Peripheriegeräte)

• Hohe Service- und Kundenorientierung

• Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Kostenlose Parkplätze

• Vergünstigungen im Läderach Café und Personalrestaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Fabio Ferramosca , Talent Acquisition Partner, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Freschezza, artigianalità, Svizzera – ecco cosa rappresenta il produttore di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, la nostra azienda familiare oggi impiega oltre 2.500 persone provenienti da circa 80 paesi in tutto il Gruppo, e la tendenza sta aumentando. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte al pittoresco paesaggio alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui.
Varie attività sono raggruppate nella nostra divisione Corporate Functions. Oltre ai nostri servizi finanziari e IT, questo settore include anche la gestione globale del marketing e delle vendite, nonché le risorse umane. Ogni giorno vengono create idee fresche, che insieme conduciamo al successo. La responsabilità personale e il lavoro in rete sono particolarmente importanti per noi. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Fornite un supporto affidabile e orientato al servizio 1 ° e 2 ° livello per i nostri rami internazionali (oltre 200 negozi)

• Elabori incidenti e richieste di assistenza in modo efficiente e orientate alla soluzione e garantisci una risoluzione dei problemi sostenibile

• Svilupperai continuamente la tua competenza di soluzione al secondo livello e affronterai argomenti sempre più complessi

• Mantenete e create Articoli, FAQ e manuali Knowledge Base per migliorare in modo sostenibile la qualità e la velocità della soluzione

• Supporti nella preparazione e nell'implementazione di aperture e conversioni di branch (IT-side)

• Installa e configura sistemi IT Store (POS, rete, periferica) sul sito o da remoto

• Visita regolarmente i nostri rami e assicura la stabilità del negozio IT

• Partecipate al servizio piketting/standby per garantire operazioni operative

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione IT completa o qualifica equivalente

• Dapprima a diversi anni di esperienza nel supporto IT (1 ° / 2 ° livello), in un ambiente al dettaglio o orientato al servizio

• Buona conoscenza dei sistemi IT/vendita (ad esempio POS, rete, periferiche)

• Alta assistenza e orientamento al cliente

• Metodo di lavoro strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

• Buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese, altre lingue benefiche

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Formazione interna ed esterna

• Opportunità di carriera individuali

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Parcheggio gratuito

• Sconti in Läderach Café e ristorante personale

Da solo. Crescete. Fallo fresco.

Sembra interessante? Allora applicaci. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner, è a vostra disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Freshness, craftsmanship, Switzerland – this is what the chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, our family business today employs more than 2,500 people from around 80 countries throughout the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of picturesque Alpine scenery, we produce our fresh chocolates here.
Various activities are bundled in our Corporate Functions division. In addition to our finance and IT services, this area also includes global marketing and sales management as well as human resources. Every day fresh ideas are created here, which together we lead to success. Personal responsibility and networked work are particularly important to us. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You provide reliable and service-oriented 1st and 2nd level support for our international branches (over 200 stores)

• You process incidents and service requests efficiently and solution-oriented and ensure sustainable troubleshooting

• You will continuously develop your own solution competence in the 2nd level and take on increasingly complex topics

• You maintain and create Knowledge Base articles, FAQs and manuals to sustainably improve solution quality and speed

• You support in the preparation and implementation of branch openings and conversions (IT-side)

• You install and configure Store IT systems (POS, network, peripheral) on site or remotely

• You regularly visit our branches and ensure the stability of Store IT

• You participate in the piketting/standby service to ensure operational operations

You bring that with you

• Completed IT training or equivalent qualification

• First to several years of experience in IT support (1st/2nd level), in a retail or service-oriented environment

• Good knowledge of store IT / retail systems (e.g. POS, network, peripherals)

• High service and customer orientation

• Structured and solution-oriented working method

• Good knowledge of German and English, other languages beneficial

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner, is at your disposal for any questions.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Freshness, artisanat, Suisse – voilà ce que représente le chocolatier Läderach. Fondée en 1962, notre entreprise familiale emploie aujourd'hui plus de 2 500 personnes de quelque 80 pays dans l'ensemble du Groupe, et la tendance est à la hausse. Le siège de l'entreprise est situé dans le canton de Glarus. Devant le pittoresque paysage alpin, nous produisons nos chocolats frais ici.
Diverses activités sont regroupées dans notre division Fonctions corporatives. Outre nos services financiers et informatiques, ce domaine comprend également la gestion du marketing mondial et des ventes ainsi que des ressources humaines. Chaque jour de nouvelles idées sont créées ici, qui ensemble nous conduisons au succès. La responsabilité personnelle et le travail en réseau sont particulièrement importants pour nous. Voulez-vous également participer? Alors venez nous voir.

C'est ce qui vous attend

• Vous fournissez un soutien fiable et axé sur le service pour nos succursales internationales (plus de 200 magasins)

• Vous traitez les incidents et les demandes de service de manière efficace et orientée vers la solution et vous assurez un dépannage durable

• Vous développerez en permanence votre propre compétence de solution au 2ème niveau et aborderez des sujets de plus en plus complexes

• Vous maintenez et créez des articles de base de connaissances, des FAQ et des manuels pour améliorer durablement la qualité et la rapidité des solutions

• Vous supportez la préparation et la mise en œuvre des ouvertures et conversions de succursales (côté IT)

• Vous installez et configurez Store IT systems (POS, réseau, périphérique) sur place ou à distance

• Vous visitez régulièrement nos branches et assurer la stabilité de Store IT

• Vous participez au service de picket/standby pour assurer les opérations

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Formation en TI terminée ou qualification équivalente

• Première à plusieurs années d'expérience dans le soutien informatique (1er/2ème niveau), dans un environnement de vente au détail ou axé sur le service

• Bonne connaissance des systèmes informatiques et de vente au détail (p. ex. POS, réseau, périphériques)

• Service élevé et orientation client

• Méthode de travail structurée et axée sur la solution

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, autres langues bénéfiques

C'est ce que nous vous offrons.

• Un environnement de travail passionnant avec des collègues motivés

• Un poste avec beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles

• L'occasion d'apporter de nouvelles idées

• Une culture de rétroaction ouverte et respectueuse

• Formation interne et externe

• Possibilités de carrière individuelles

• Des rabais généreux sur nos produits

• Chocolat sur le lieu de travail

• Parking gratuit

• Réductions en Läderach Café et restaurant du personnel

Pose-le. Fais grandir. Fais-le frais.

Ça semble intéressant ? Alors appliquez-nous. Fabio Ferramosca, associé d'acquisition de talents, est à votre disposition pour toutes questions.

Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

• Du gehst aktiv auf unsere Kundinnen und Kunden ein, erkennst ihre Bedürfnisse und bietest passende Lösungen an

• Du kümmerst dich um die Kassiervorgänge und sorgst für eine präzise und korrekte Abrechnung

• Du präsentierst das erlesene Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiment auf eine geschmackvolle und einladende Weise

• Du übernimmst auch produzierende Tätigkeiten sowie das Auffüllen und die Pflege der Verkaufsflächen

• Du setzt unsere hohen Qualitätsstandards mit Hingabe und Sorgfalt um

• Du achtest konsequent auf die Einhaltung des Hygiene- und Frischekonzepts

• Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinem Team und trägst zu einem positiven Arbeitsklima bei

• Du bringst Berufserfahrung im Detailhandel mit und begeisterst dich für den Verkauf sowie den direkten Kundenkontakt

• Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und berätst freundlich, individuell und überzeugend

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französisch und weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil

• Du arbeitest verantwortungsbewusst, zuverlässig und qualitätsorientiert und hältst Hygiene- und Sauberkeitsstandards konsequent ein

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest dich im Verkauf und Service weiterentwickeln

• Du bist flexibel und bereit für Einsätze an Wochenenden und Feiertagen

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Romina Labriola, Filialleiterin, +41 55 410 30 70, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

La divisione “Retail” comprende più di 250 cioccolatini in più di 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare il cioccolato fresco ancora e ancora. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Rispondete attivamente ai nostri clienti, riconoscete le loro esigenze e offrite soluzioni adeguate

• Prendersi cura dei processi di cassa e garantire una fatturazione precisa e corretta

• Vi presentiamo la squisita gamma di confiserie e cioccolato in un modo raffinato e invitante

• Si occupa anche di attività di produzione, nonché il riempimento e la manutenzione delle aree di vendita

• Attui i nostri standard di alta qualità con dedizione e cura

• Riconosci le esigenze del cliente rapidamente e consiglia amichevole, individuale e convincente

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese; francese e altre lingue sono utili

• Si lavora in modo responsabile, affidabile e orientato alla qualità e rispettare costantemente gli standard di igiene e pulizia

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, come assumersi la responsabilità e vogliono svilupparsi in vendite e servizi

• Sei flessibile e pronto per le assegnazioni nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Buona accessibilità dei luoghi

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring that with you

• You bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Romina Labriola, store manager, +41 55 410 30 70, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

In front of the picturesque alpine scenery, we produce our fresh chocolates and develop new, innovative ideas in the teams of the company. The "Retail" division comprises over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries.

Here we offer our chocolate specialities and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you want to participate in this? Then come to us.

That's what awaits you

• You advise our customer-oriented and sell our diverse range of goods, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively engage our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cashing operations and ensure a precise and correct settlement

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate assortment in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on manufacturing activities and the filling and maintenance of the sales space

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring this with you

• You bring professional experience in retail and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You quickly recognize customer needs and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are of advantage

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, are happy to take responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for weekend and public holidays (fixed days: Tuesday, Friday, Saturday)

We'll give you that

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The possibility of bringing fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate at the workplace

• Good accessibility of the sites

Sounds interesting? Apply with us. Jasmin Anderegg, branch manager, +41 44 830 55 24 is at your disposal if you have any questions.

Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative nelle squadre agili.
La divisione “Retail” comprende più di 250 cioccolatini in più di 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare il cioccolato fresco ancora e ancora. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Si consiglia di orientare il cliente e vendere la nostra gamma di prodotti diversi, per esempio nella selezione di regali

• Rispondete attivamente ai nostri clienti, riconoscete le loro esigenze e offrite soluzioni adeguate

• Prendersi cura dei processi di cassa e garantire una fatturazione precisa e corretta

• Vi presentiamo la squisita gamma di confiserie e cioccolato in un modo raffinato e invitante

• Si occupa anche di attività di produzione, nonché il riempimento e la manutenzione delle aree di vendita

• Attui i nostri standard di alta qualità con dedizione e cura

• Si presta costantemente attenzione al rispetto del concetto di igiene e freschezza

• Lavori di pari passo con il tuo team e contribuisci a un ambiente di lavoro positivo

Lo porti con te.

• Porti esperienza professionale nel commercio al dettaglio e sei entusiasta delle vendite e del contatto diretto con i clienti

• Riconosci le esigenze del cliente rapidamente e consiglia amichevole, individuale e convincente

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese; francese e altre lingue sono utili

• Si lavora in modo responsabile, affidabile e orientato alla qualità e rispettare costantemente gli standard di igiene e pulizia

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, come assumersi la responsabilità e vogliono svilupparsi in vendite e servizi

• Sei flessibile e pronto per le assegnazioni nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Buona accessibilità dei luoghi

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring that with you

• You bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Tamara Sindin, branch manager, +41 61 263 17 70, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

La sede centrale dell'azienda si trova nel cantone di Glarona. Di fronte al pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi e sviluppiamo nuove idee creative nei team del Gruppo Alain. Oltre ai nostri servizi finanziari e IT, abbiamo anche marketing globale e gestione delle vendite, nonché capitale umano. Qui vengono create idee fresche, che conduciamo insieme al successo.
