descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi siamo

Cioccolato fresco di alta qualità: questo è ciò che rappresenta la manifattura svizzera di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda a conduzione familiare impiega oggi oltre 2500 persone provenienti da oltre 80 paesi in tutto il gruppo, con una tendenza in aumento. La sede principale dell'azienda si trova nel Canton Glarona. In uno scenario alpino pittoresco, produciamo qui i nostri cioccolatini freschi e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative in team agili.

La divisione "Retail" comprende oltre 250 cioccolaterie in oltre 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità al cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a rivivere il cioccolato fresco più e più volte. Vuoi partecipare anche tu? Allora vieni da noi.

Compiti

- Consulenza orientata al cliente e vendita della nostra vasta gamma di prodotti, ad esempio nella scelta dei regali
- Interagisci attivamente con i nostri clienti, riconosci le loro esigenze e offri soluzioni adeguate
- Ti occupi delle operazioni di cassa e ti occupi di una fatturazione precisa e corretta
- Presenti la raffinata gamma di confetterie e cioccolatini in modo gustoso e invitante
- Ti occupi anche delle attività produttive, nonché del riempimento e della manutenzione degli spazi di vendita
- Metti in pratica i nostri elevati standard di qualità con dedizione e cura
- Presti costante attenzione al rispetto del concetto di igiene e freschezza
- Lavori mano nella mano con il tuo team e contribuisci a un risultato positivo
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

High quality fresh chocolate – this is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family-owned company employs more than 2,200 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and is now increasingly active. The company's headquarters is located in the canton of Glarus. In front of the picturesque alpine scenery, we produce our fresh chocolates here and develop new innovative ideas in the teams of the Alain.

The "Retail" division comprises over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialities and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you want to participate in this? Then come to us.

Tasks

- You advise our customers and sell our diverse range of goods, for example in the selection of gifts - You actively engage our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions - You take care of the cashier processes and ensure precise and correct billing - You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate assortment in a tasteful and inviting way - You also take over production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of the sales areas - You set our high quality standards with dedication and

Care for - You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept - You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

Requirements

- You have professional experience in retail and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact - You quickly recognize customer needs and advise friendly, individual and convincing - You have very good German and English skills; French and other languages are of benefit - You work responsibly, reliably and quality oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards - You are a team player, you are happy to take responsibility and want to develop yourself in sales and service - You are flexible and

ready for weekend and public holidays

We offer

- An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues - A position with a lot of personal responsibility - The possibility of bringing in fresh ideas - An open and respectful feedback culture - Generous discounts on our products - Chocolate at the workplace - Good accessibility of the sites

Contact

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Franziska Christa Engesser, branch manager, +41 44 212 18 48, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for understanding that we do not take external personnel agencies into account when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring that with you

• You bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Bettina Pierri, store manager, +41 71 222 18 46, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du berätst kundenorientiert und verkaufst unser vielfältiges Warensortiment, zum Beispiel bei der Geschenkauswahl

• Du gehst aktiv auf unsere Kundinnen und Kunden ein, erkennst ihre Bedürfnisse und bietest passende Lösungen an

• Du kümmerst dich um die Kassiervorgänge und sorgst für eine präzise und korrekte Abrechnung

• Du präsentierst das erlesene Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiment auf eine geschmackvolle und einladende Weise

• Du übernimmst auch produzierende Tätigkeiten sowie das Auffüllen und die Pflege der Verkaufsflächen

• Du setzt unsere hohen Qualitätsstandards mit Hingabe und Sorgfalt um

• Du achtest konsequent auf die Einhaltung des Hygiene- und Frischekonzepts

• Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinem Team und trägst zu einem positiven Arbeitsklima bei

Das bringst du mit

• Du bringst Berufserfahrung im Detailhandel mit und begeisterst dich für den Verkauf sowie den direkten Kundenkontakt

• Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und berätst freundlich, individuell und überzeugend

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französisch und weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil

• Du arbeitest verantwortungsbewusst, zuverlässig und qualitätsorientiert und hältst Hygiene- und Sauberkeitsstandards konsequent ein

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest dich im Verkauf und Service weiterentwickeln

• Du bist flexibel und bereit für Einsätze an Wochenenden und Feiertagen

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chocolat frais de haute qualité – c'est ce que représente le fabricant suisse de chocolat Läderach. Fondée en 1962, l'entreprise familiale emploie aujourd'hui plus de 2 500 personnes de plus de 80 pays dans l'ensemble du Groupe, et la tendance est à la hausse. Le siège de l'entreprise est situé dans le canton de Glarus. Devant un décor alpin pittoresque, nous produisons ici nos chocolats frais et développons constamment de nouvelles idées innovantes en équipe agile.
La division « Retail » comprend plus de 250 chocolateries dans plus de 30 pays. Ici, nous offrons nos spécialités de chocolat et invitons les clients à découvrir le chocolat frais encore et encore. Voulez-vous également participer? Alors venez nous voir.

C'est ce qui vous attend

• Vous conseillez le client et vendez notre gamme de produits, par exemple dans la sélection de cadeaux

• Vous répondez activement à nos clients, reconnaissez leurs besoins et offrez des solutions adaptées

• Vous prenez soin des processus de trésorerie et assurez une facturation précise et correcte

• Vous présentez la confiserie exquise et la gamme de chocolats d'une manière agréable et accueillante

• Vous prenez également des activités de production ainsi que le remplissage et l'entretien des zones de vente

• Vous appliquez nos normes de haute qualité avec dévouement et soin

• Vous faites toujours attention au respect du concept d'hygiène et de fraîcheur

• Vous travaillez main dans la main avec votre équipe et contribuez à un environnement de travail positif

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Vous apportez une expérience professionnelle dans le commerce de détail et êtes enthousiaste à propos des ventes et contact direct avec le client

• Vous reconnaissez les besoins du client rapidement et conseillez amical, individuel et convaincant

• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais; le français et d'autres langues sont bénéfiques

• Vous travaillez de manière responsable, fiable et orientée vers la qualité et vous respectez constamment les normes d'hygiène et de propreté

• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe, aimez prendre des responsabilités et voulez développer dans les ventes et le service

• Vous êtes flexible et prêt pour les affectations le week-end et les vacances

C'est ce que nous vous offrons.

• Un environnement de travail passionnant avec des collègues motivés

• Un poste avec beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles

• L'occasion d'apporter de nouvelles idées

• Une culture de rétroaction ouverte et respectueuse

• Des rabais généreux sur nos produits

• Chocolat sur le lieu de travail

• Bonne accessibilité des sites

Ça semble intéressant ? Alors appliquez-nous. Santino Gaido, +41 52 203 34 86, est à votre disposition pour toutes questions.

Nous demandons que vous compreniez que nous ne prenons pas en considération les agences de recrutement externes pour combler ce poste.

Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, kreative Ideen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du liebst Schoggi

• Du hast einen Sekundarschulabchluss (A) oder einen guten Realschulabschluss (B)

• Du besitzt eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und bevorzugst ein dynamisches Umfeld

• Du magst den Kontakt zu Menschen und bist kommunikativ

• Du schätzt eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Zuverlässigkeit

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.
Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Franziska Engesser, Telefon +41 44 212 18 48, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Cioccolato fresco di alta qualità – ecco cosa rappresenta il produttore svizzero di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee creative in team agili.
La divisione “Retail” comprende più di 230 cioccolatini in più di 25 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare il cioccolato fresco ancora e ancora.
Avrete la possibilità di completare una formazione EFZ pluriennale per il commercio al dettaglio in una delle nostre cioccolaterie svizzere. Qui imparerai come consigliare competentemente i clienti, decorare vetrine e scaffali del negozio e organizzare diversi processi di lavoro. Vi familiarizziamo con le normative igieniche e le leggi alimentari e vi presentiamo l'ordine.
Vuoi entrare nel mondo professionale e imparare cose nuove? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Sarete sostenuti e accompagnati da noi durante il passaggio tra scuola e mondo professionale

• Sarete curati individualmente e personalmente dai nostri dirigenti

• Riceverai una formazione diversificata e pratica con ottime prospettive

Lo porti con te.

• Tu ami Schoggi

• Hai un diploma di scuola secondaria (A) o una buona scuola secondaria (B)

• Hai una comprensione rapida e preferisci un ambiente dinamico

• Ti piace il contatto con le persone e sono comunicativi

• Apprezzi un attento metodo di lavoro e affidabilità

Da solo. Crescete. Fallo fresco.
Sembra interessante? Allora applicaci. Franziska Engesser, telefono +41 44 212 18 48, è a vostra disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.
descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, creative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 230 chocolateries in more than 25 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again.
You will get the chance to complete a multi-year EFZ training for the retail trade in one of our Swiss chocolateries. There you will learn how to competently advise customers, decorate shop windows and shelves and organize different work processes. We familiarize you with hygiene regulations and food laws and introduce you to ordering.
Do you want to enter the professional world and learn new things? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You will be supported and accompanied by us during the step between school and professional world

• You will be looked after individually and personally by our branch managers

• You will receive a diverse, practical education with very good prospects

You bring that with you

• You love Schoggi

• You have a secondary school degree (A) or a good secondary school degree (B)

• You have a fast comprehension and prefer a dynamic environment

• You like contact with people and are communicative

• You appreciate a careful working method and reliability

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.
Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Franziska Engesser, telephone +41 44 212 18 48, is at your disposal for any questions.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You advise customer-oriented and sell our diverse product range, for example in the selection of gifts

• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions

• You take care of the cash processes and ensure a precise and correct billing

• You present the exquisite confiserie and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way

• You also take on production activities as well as the filling and maintenance of sales areas

• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care

• You consistently pay attention to compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept

• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working environment

You bring that with you

• You bring professional experience in the retail trade and are enthusiastic about sales and direct customer contact

• You recognize customer needs quickly and advise friendly, individual and convincing

• You have very good knowledge of German and English; French and other languages are beneficial

• You work responsibly, reliably and quality-oriented and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards

• You are a team player, like to take on responsibility and want to develop in sales and service

• You are flexible and ready for assignments on weekends and holidays

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Nina Lauber, branch manager, +41 27 967 43 73, is at your disposal for any questions.
Please note that we do not provide apartments.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
In our production, we produce fresh couvertures from high-quality raw materials. Afterwards, we process and refine the liquid chocolates in our chocolate factory to form FrischSchoggi, pralinés, truffes, figures and much more. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You will develop new innovative products for our international markets according to our quality standards (food safety, raw material assessment, sustainability, etc.)

• You carry out development projects independently, with all development-relevant phases from prototype to introduction to production

• You work closely with marketing, manufacturing team and quality management to ensure timely market launch

• You work with purchasing and suppliers in the procurement of raw materials and production materials

• You ensure the data quality in the ERP system and maintain it

• You strengthen the innovation potential as well as the craftsmanship and technological know-how

• You advise and support the production professionally in quality and efficiency optimizations.

• You are a member of the internal sensor team

You bring that with you

• You have completed vocational training as a confiser or several years of experience as a chocolatier and have several years of professional experience in dealing with Couverture

• You have a strong quality awareness, craftsmanship, attention to detail and a high degree of creativity

• Keep up to date with the latest developments in products, ingredients, technologies and trends

• You are used to working independently, recognize and set priorities and work in a structured way

• You have good communication and cooperation skills to work across functions and ideally bring experience in project management

• You have very good language skills in German and ideally bring knowledge in English

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. In front of the picturesque alpine scenery, we produce our fresh chocolates and develop new creative ideas in the teams of the Alain Group. Our "91 Functions" division comprises various activities.

• You are a team of players with hands-on mentality and communicate safely in German and English

We'll give you that

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cioccolato fresco di alta qualità – ecco cosa rappresenta il produttore svizzero di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi impiega più di 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del Gruppo, e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative nelle squadre agili.
La nostra divisione Gestione della Supply Chain è responsabile di tutte le catene di approvvigionamento. Questo include anche l'acquisto e la logistica di magazzino. Dal nostro magazzino principale a Bilten, organizziamo il flusso di merci e forniamo i nostri cioccolatini e magazzini in tutto il mondo. Vuoi anche partecipare? Allora vieni da noi.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Garantisci la fornitura di servizi presso i siti Bilten e Ennenda nei settori degli edifici, dei dintorni e del servizio tecnico secondo il mandato e gli obiettivi della BRL TD

• Garantisci la funzionalità, la disponibilità e la conservazione del valore di edifici, infrastrutture e strutture

• Voi rispettate le normative operative e igieniche e sostenete la loro coerente implementazione, anche verso gli assemblatori esterni

• Lavori in modo collaborativo e orientato al team con tutti i dipartimenti e le posizioni coinvolte e contribuisci secondo la dichiarazione di missione di Läderach (Schweiz) AG

• Effettuare lavori di manutenzione, pulizia e controllo, effettuare riparazioni minori e servizio invernale e garantire un adeguato smaltimento dei rifiuti

• Assicura la pulizia nel laboratorio e sul luogo di lavoro e fornisce il servizio Pikett per risolvere rapidamente i problemi tecnici

Lo porti con te.

• Porti esperienza in upkeep e piccole riparazioni a edifici e dintorni

• Avete conoscenza del servizio e della manutenzione della tecnologia di costruzione e delle strutture tecniche

• Lavori in modo sicuro, professionale e orientato alla soluzione nelle riparazioni e conosci lo smaltimento professionale dei materiali residui

• Siete pronti a partecipare al servizio tecnico e al servizio pikett

• Pensate avanti e coinvolgetevi con idee per un ulteriore sviluppo della tecnologia domestica, degli edifici e dei dintorni

• Lavorate con attenzione, strutturate e assicurate una documentazione affidabile

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Formazione interna ed esterna

• Opportunità di carriera individuali

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Parcheggio gratuito

• Sconti in Läderach Café e ristorante personale

Da solo. Crescete. Fallo fresco.

Sembra interessante? Allora applicaci. Juan Marfil, Responsabile del Servizio Tecnico, è a vostra disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.

Chiediamo la vostra comprensione che non consideriamo agenzie di reclutamento esterne durante il riempimento di questa posizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
Our Supply Chain Management division is responsible for all supply chains. This also includes purchasing and warehouse logistics. From our main warehouse in Bilten, we organize the flow of goods and supply our chocolateries and warehouses around the world. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You ensure the provision of services at the Bilten and Ennenda sites in the areas of buildings, surroundings and technical service in accordance with the mandate and objectives of the BRL TD

• You ensure the functionality, availability and value preservation of buildings, infrastructure and facilities

• You comply with the operating and hygiene regulations and support their consistent implementation, also towards external assemblers

• You work in a team-oriented and cooperative manner with all departments and positions involved and contribute according to the mission statement of Läderach (Schweiz) AG

• You carry out maintenance, cleaning and control work, take over minor repairs as well as winter service and ensure proper waste disposal

• You ensure cleanliness in the workshop and workplace and provide Pikett service to quickly resolve technical problems

You bring that with you

• You bring experience in upkeep and minor repairs to buildings and surroundings

• You have knowledge of service and maintenance of building technology and technical facilities

• You work safely, professionally and solution-oriented in repairs and know the professional disposal of residual materials

• You are ready to participate in the technical service as well as in the pikett service

• You think ahead and get involved with ideas for the further development of home technology, buildings and surroundings

• You work carefully, structured and ensure reliable documentation

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Juan Marfil, Head of Technical Service, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

titleByLocale.fr: Apprentissage dans le commerce de détail EFZ 2027 (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, kreative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 230 Chocolaterien in über 25 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben.
Du erhältst die Chance, in einer unserer Schweizer Chocolaterien eine mehrjährige EFZ-Ausbildung für den Detailhandel zu absolvieren. Dort lernst du, wie du Kundinnen und Kunden kompetent berätst, Schaufenster und Regale dekorierst und verschiedene Arbeitsabläufe organisierst. Wir machen dich mit Hygienevorschriften und Lebensmittelgesetzen vertraut und führen dich ins Bestellwesen ein.
Hast du Lust, in die Berufswelt einzusteigen und Neues zu lernen? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du wirst beim Schritt zwischen Schule und Berufswelt von uns unterstützt und begleitet

• Du wirst individuell und persönlich durch unsere Filialleiterinnen betreut

• Du erhältst eine vielfältige, praxisorientierte Ausbildung mit sehr guten Perspektiven

Das bringst du mit

• Du liebst Schoggi

• Du hast einen Sekundarschulabchluss (A) oder einen guten Realschulabschluss (B)

• Du besitzt eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und bevorzugst ein dynamisches Umfeld

• Du magst den Kontakt zu Menschen und bist kommunikativ

• Du schätzt eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Zuverlässigkeit

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.
Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Tamara Saxer, Telefon +41 44 651 13 33, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

La nostra divisione Gestione della Supply Chain è responsabile di tutte le catene di approvvigionamento. Questo include anche l'acquisto e la logistica di magazzino. Dal nostro magazzino principale a Bilten, organizziamo il flusso di merci e forniamo i nostri cioccolatini e magazzini in tutto il mondo.

Vuoi entrare nel mondo professionale e imparare cose nuove? Allora vieni da noi.

• Si opera ovunque merce arriva, viene spedito, consegnato, trasportato e memorizzato

• Crea i documenti di consegna e assicurati la corretta documentazione delle spedizioni

• Caricare i veicoli professionalmente e prestare attenzione a un carico sicuro ed efficiente

• Avrai l'opportunità di fare la licenza del conducente per il carrello elevatore durante l'allenamento

• Passerete attraverso diversi dipartimenti della nostra azienda per conoscere tutte le aree pertinenti

• Un apprendistato emozionante con colleghi motivati

• L'opportunità di sniffare in altre aree della società

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, creative ideas in agile teams.
Our Supply Chain Management division is responsible for all supply chains. This also includes purchasing and warehouse logistics. From our main warehouse in Bilten, we organize the flow of goods and supply our chocolateries and warehouses around the world.
You will get the chance to complete a multi-year EFZ training in the field of logistics in our warehouse. There you will learn how merchandise and our chocolates are transported and stored properly. We will show you how to pack products for shipping, create delivery documents and load vehicles properly. In addition, you have the opportunity to make a driver's license for the forklift.
Do you want to enter the professional world and learn new things? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You operate wherever merchandise arrives, is shipped, delivered, transported and stored

• You package and label the products and ensure proper labelling

• You create the delivery documents and ensure the correct documentation of the shipments

• You load the vehicles professionally and pay attention to a safe and efficient loading

• You will get the opportunity to make the driver's license for the forklift truck during your training

• You will go through different departments of our company to get to know all relevant areas

• You start with an all-round package in your later workday and are well prepared

You bring that with you

• You are interested in logistical tasks

• You work carefully and are well organized

• You have craftsmanship

• You enjoy physical work and like to tackle

• You like working with computer and scanner

This is what we offer you

• An exciting apprenticeship with motivated colleagues

• The opportunity to sniff into other areas of the company

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Good accessibility of locations

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Daniel Hensler, telephone +41 55 645 77 49, is at your disposal for any questions.

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, kreative Ideen.
In unserem Unternehmensbereich «Corporate Functions» sind verschiedene Tätigkeiten gebündelt. Neben unseren Finance- und IT-Services sind in diesem Bereich auch das globale Marketing und Sales Management sowie Human Resources angesiedelt. Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du gestaltest die Zukunft unserer globalen Analytics- und Reporting-Plattform und verantwortest deren strategische Weiterentwicklung auf Basis moderner Microsoft-Technologien

• Du entwickelst die globale Power BI- und Data-Warehouse-Roadmap, steuerst das Product Backlog, priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt Business-Bedürfnisse in klare technische Umsetzungspakete

• Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, IT und Projektleitungen, führst interne sowie externe Power BI- und DWH-Spezialisten fachlich und stellst eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit aller Beteiligten sicher

• Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Power BI- und Data-Warehouse-Services und gewährleistest Verfügbarkeit, Performance, Servicequalität sowie eine kontinuierliche Optimierung der Plattform

• Du definierst und überwachst SLAs, KPIs und OLAs, steuerst Support-, Wartungs- und Release-Prozesse und koordinierst Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern

• Du entwickelst die zentrale DWH-Architektur weiter, integrierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellsystemen wie ERP, CRM, Produktion und Retail und stellst eine konsistente sowie verlässliche Datenbasis sicher

• Du verantwortest Datenqualität, Datenkonsistenz und Data-Governance-Prozesse, definierst Standards, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst die Einhaltung von Compliance- und Datenschutzanforderungen sicher

• Du entwickelst moderne Analytics- und Self-Service-BI-Konzepte weiter, definierst Datenmodelle, Kennzahlen und Reporting-Standards und befähigst Fachbereiche zu datenbasierten Entscheidungen

• Du steuerst externe Dienstleister und Implementierungspartner, verantwortest Budget- und Ressourcenplanung und unterstützt internationale Projekte, Technologieevaluierungen sowie Architekturentscheidungen

• Du treibst die globale Datenstrategie aktiv voran und leistest mit deiner Expertise einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur digitalen Transformation und Weiterentwicklung unserer Analytics-Landschaft

Das bringst du mit

• Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse oder Analytics mit

• Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Power BI sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Data-Warehouse-Architekturen, SQL und Datenmodellierung

• Du kennst dich mit ETL-/ELT-Prozessen aus und verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für Data Governance, Data Quality Management und den nachhaltigen Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten

• Du hast Erfahrung im Betrieb geschäftskritischer IT-Services und bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse in Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Platform oder vergleichbaren modernen Cloud-Technologien mit

• Du verfügst von Vorteil über Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen und verstehst die Anforderungen komplexer Unternehmensdatenlandschaften

• Du hast bereits als Product Owner, Service Owner oder Business Analyst gearbeitet und bist vertraut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban sowie ITIL-Prozessen

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und lösungsorientiert und überzeugst durch ausgeprägtes Stakeholder-Management sowie Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner

• Du zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Kunden-, Team- und Serviceorientierung aus und bringst Eigeninitiative sowie eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf allen Organisationsebenen und kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen vermitteln

• Du denkst unternehmerisch, bist ergebnisorientiert, identifizierst dich mit der Läderach Charta und verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Kostenlose Parkplätze

• Vergünstigungen im Läderach Café und Personalrestaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda a conduzione familiare occupa più di 2.200 persone provenienti da oltre 80 paesi, ed è ora sempre più attiva nel gruppo. La sede centrale dell'azienda si trova nel cantone di Glarona. Di fronte al pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi e sviluppiamo nuove idee creative nei team del Gruppo Alain. La nostra divisione "91 Funzioni" comprende varie attività.

Oltre ai nostri servizi finanziari e IT, abbiamo anche marketing globale e gestione delle vendite, nonché capitale umano. Qui vengono create idee fresche, che conduciamo insieme al successo. Ci preoccupiamo della nostra responsabilità e del lavoro connesso. Vuoi partecipare a questo? Allora vieni da noi.

Ecco cosa ti aspetta.

• Si modella il futuro della nostra piattaforma di analisi e reporting globale e sono responsabili per il suo sviluppo strategico basato sulle moderne tecnologie Microsoft

• Sviluppate la roadmap globale BI e data warehouse, controllate il prodotto arretrato, eliminate i requisiti e tradotte le esigenze aziendali in pacchetti di implementazione tecnica chiari

• Sei l'interfaccia centrale tra business, IT e project management, gestisci il potere interno ed esterno BI e DW specialisti professionalmente e garantisci una cooperazione efficiente tra tutte le parti interessate

• Lei assume la responsabilità end-to-end per i Servizi di Power BI e Data Warehouse e garantisce disponibilità, prestazioni, qualità del servizio e ottimizzazione continua della piattaforma

• Definisci e monitori SLA, KPI e oles, supporto di controllo, manutenzione e processi di rilascio e coordina la gestione degli incidenti, dei problemi e dei cambiamenti insieme a partner interni ed esterni

• Continuate a sviluppare l'architettura DWH centrale, a integrare i dati provenienti da diversi sistemi di origine come ERP, CRM, produzione e retail e a garantire una base dati coerente e affidabile

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 3000 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
In our production, we produce fresh couvertures from high-quality raw materials. Afterwards, we process and refine the liquid chocolates in our chocolate factory to form FrischSchoggi, pralinés, truffes, figures and much more. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You independently supervise special facilities and assume responsibility for maintenance in the area of mechanics and mechatronics

• You are responsible for the provision of services in the area of technical service, in particular for repairs and maintenance work according to the order and objectives

• You analyze faults and errors and take care of their sustainable correction through modifications or changes

• You plan and carry out revisions and maintenance work on the plants

• Ensure that all facilities, machinery, infrastructure and buildings in Ennenda and Bilten are operational and available at all times

• You pay attention to compliance with operational safety and actively help to enforce it

You bring that with you

• You have in-depth experience as a mechanic in the automotive industry and have received comprehensive training in the field of mechatronics

• You have craftsmanship and an in-depth technical understanding of all equipment, both in buildings and on production machinery.

• You have additional knowledge in areas such as pneumatics, hydraulics, electrics and PLC control

• Welding experience (ideally TIG and also MIG/MAG) as well as knowledge of mechanical manufacturing techniques such as milling and turning are advantageous

• You are physically resilient and have experienced PC skills

• You are ready to work in the pikettdienst and have a driving license

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Juan Marfil, Head of Technical Service, tel. 055 645 77 71, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du arbeitest gerne mit Schokolade

• Du wirkst aktiv bei der Herstellung von Schokoladenprodukten in der Liveproduction mit

• Du stellst Confiserie-Artikel von Hand nach Vorgabe her und kreierst spezielle sowie saisonale Schokoladenprodukte

• Du entwickelst kreative Ideen und setzt diese erfolgreich um, unterstützt das Team bei Live-Events und Präsentationen

• Du berätst und unterstützt die Kundschaft bei individuellen Kundenbestellungen

• Du betreust unsere Gäste im Walk-in Atelier und bist im direkten Austausch mit unseren Besuchern

• Du führst Kurse rund um das Thema Schokolade in unserem Atelier durch

• Du stellst die Einhaltung der Qualitätsstandards sicher und setzt die Hygienevorschriften gemäss HACCP konsequent um

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast Berufserfahrung in der Animation, Gastronomie oder Hotellerie

• Du besitzt ein kreatives Gespür und Freude daran, Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen – sei es bei Schokoladen-Dekorationen oder innovativen Konzepten für die Live-Produktion

• Du bist eine extrovertierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne den Kontakt zu Gästen sucht

• Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Schokolade und eine ausgeprägte Gastgebermentalität

• Du trittst mit einem gepflegten Erscheinungsbild und professionellem Auftreten auf

• Du zeigst hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und arbeitest stark teamorientiert

• Deine Begeisterung für die Arbeit wirkt ansteckend und schafft eine positive Atmosphäre für die Gäste

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und überzeugst durch deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Möglichkeit zum Schokoladengenuss am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Annett Kraft, HoL Team Leader Live Production, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.
